name: shipgate-hud
description: A Claude Code mod that draws a shipgate flow's position: stream, phase, tasks and verify evidence in a band above the prompt, and a phase-aware pane with the gate decisions (veto in one press), the Build Plan with journal evidence, and the committed design. Reads shipgate's journal through its CLI; draws nothing in a project without a shipgate journal.

journalScript.title: journal.py path
journalScript.description: Absolute path to shipgate's scripts/journal.py when the HUD cannot find it beside itself (marketplace checkout or plugin cache).
